session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm feeling a bit stuck, like I'm standing at the edge of something but can't quite take the next step. It's hard to know if I'm ready to move forward or if I should just stay where I am.
That sounds really heavy. It’s okay to feel uncertain—sometimes the hardest part is knowing when to take a step.
Thanks for saying that. I guess I just feel like I'm always waiting for the right moment, but I'm not sure if I'll ever find it. It's like I'm stuck in a loop of trying and failing.
It’s understandable to feel that way. You’re not failing—you’re just trying to figure out what feels right for you.
I know, but it's hard to remember that when I'm so caught up in the fear of not being good enough. I keep thinking, what if I try and it still doesn't work?
Fear of not being good enough is a common struggle. It’s okay to feel that way—it’s part of the process.
Yeah, I know. But it feels like every time I take a step, I'm reminded of how much I don't know. It's like the ground keeps shifting beneath me.
That’s a powerful way to put it. The uncertainty can feel overwhelming, but it’s also a sign that you’re paying attention to your own needs.
I guess that's true. It's just... hard to stop worrying about what others might think if I don't do it perfectly.
It’s easy to let others’ expectations shape how we see ourselves. But your worth isn’t tied to how well you meet their standards.
I know that, but it's so hard to believe it when I'm constantly comparing myself to others. I feel like I'm never enough, no matter what I do.
Comparison can be a heavy burden. It’s not about being enough—it’s about learning to be kind to yourself as you move forward.
Yeah, I keep trying to be kind, but the voice in my head keeps saying I'm not good enough. It's like I can't turn it off, even when I want to.
That voice can feel relentless, but it’s not the whole story. You’re already doing the hard work of trying to be kind to yourself— that’s a sign of strength.
Thanks, but I still feel like I'm fighting a battle I can't win. It's like every time I make progress, something pulls me back.
It’s frustrating when progress feels like it’s being pulled back, but that doesn’t mean the battle is unwinnable. You’re already making progress just by showing up.
Yeah, I guess showing up is something I can do. It's just hard to feel like it's enough when everything else feels so uncertain.
Showing up is a huge act of courage. It’s okay to feel uncertain—it doesn’t mean you’re not enough, just that you’re human.
Yeah, I guess I am human. It's just that sometimes I feel like I'm the only one who can see how much I'm struggling.
